apps.localizedDescription: A free and open-source PlayStation 2 (PS2) emulator based on PCSX2, with native ARM64 JIT recompilers. Play PS2 games on your phone, PC, or gaming handheld.

versions.localizedDescription:
Automated nightly build for community testing (unsigned).

Every download is named `ARMSX2-nightly-DATE-COMMIT-PLATFORM`, so builds
from different nights stay distinguishable after you have downloaded them.

- macOS arm64: macOS-arm64.tar.xz
- Linux arm64: Linux-arm64-4K-pages.AppImage on most distros, or the 16K one on Asahi Linux and other Apple Silicon kernels (run getconf PAGESIZE if unsure)
- Windows arm64: Windows-arm64.zip
- RetroArch on Linux arm64: Linux-arm64-libretro-core.tar.zst, a 4K-page build
- Bare-display kmsdrm handhelds: Linux-arm64-SDL-handheld.tar.zst, a 4K-page build (Rocknix and Batocera run compositors, so use the Qt AppImage there instead)
- Android: Android-arm64.apk (installs as ARMSX2 Nightly, alongside the stable app)
- iOS: iOS-arm64.ipa, unsigned, sideload it

Coming from an old nightly? It is now a separate app (ARMSX2 Nightly) that installs
beside the stable app. The old nightly cannot install a stable over itself, because
Android refuses that version downgrade, so to return to stable: back up your saves
and memory cards, uninstall the old nightly, then install a stable APK.

## What's new
- remove an unneeded file
- iOS: let a derived number format keep its literal readout
- iOS: halve the per-game reads behind the resolution poll
- iOS: read the pad layout identity without parsing the INI
- iOS: drop the container path fragments that cannot match
- iOS: use the root Pcsx2Utils instead of the iOS fork
- iOS: drop the tab bar pill that cannot be reached
- Android: each package follows one channel; harden the nightly package guard
- CMake: derive the build version from ARMSX2 tags, not nightly or upstream tags
- Android: ship nightlies as a separate com.armsx2.nightly app
- iOS: drop the Swift declarations nothing references
- iOS: drop the per-game bridge methods nothing calls
- iOS: pin the export prompt and the zip entry caps
- iOS: confirm the destination before a link exports the library
- iOS: bound what a zip entry can unpack to
- Common: one Darwin clock and sleep path for iOS and macOS
- iOS: consolidate the per-game INI and settings bridge methods
- iOS: remove the dead compatibility lab and bisect methods
- iOS: stream frame time history as raw bytes
- iOS: reuse the bridge's BIOS scanning and drop the dead document picker
- iOS: simplify the skin browser filter and its alert bindings
- Android: park the CPU thread for disc swaps and quiet the park guard
- iOS: build the two localized screens again
- macOS: correct tick conversion in SleepUntil
- Android: pause the VM from the CPU thread when writing a save state

Full changelog: https://github.com/ARMSX2/ARMSX2/compare/nightly-20260917...8b5fad23dc290660aa394e75b0fd23e31099eaec
